title.ja: 中性長方形スラブ：真2P参照とYB補正
title.en: Neutral rectangular slab: genuine2P reference and YB

summary.ja: 4電荷の長方形3P Ewaldに中性スラブ補正を加え、別実装の真2P和のエネルギー・全力成分と照合します。
summary.en: Compare corrected orthorhombic3P Ewald energy/all forces against a separately implemented genuine2P series.

assumptions.en: Coulomb1, lateral1×1.25, extendedLz1.5/3/6,4neutral charges±1,physical-z dipole.34 andalpha3/4.

algorithm.ja: 全±3D波数、自己項、2pi Mz²/Vとその力。独立2Pには横零モード・自己減算と安定exp–erfcを保持。
algorithm.en: Full±3D reciprocal sum/self term and2pi Mz²/V correction; independent2P retains zero/self terms and stable exp-erfc evaluation.

validation.ja: 参照alpha/打切り資格、エネルギー差分、真空厚、全力、零モード負対照・遠方ゲージと中性平行移動を分離。
validation.en: Separate reference cutoff/splitting qualification, energy gradients, vacuum error, all forces, zero-mode control/far gauge and neutral translations.

limits.ja: 中性・固定4電荷・Cartesian z法線のみ。YBは有限ギャップ近似で任意真空の厳密2Pではありません。原著YB本文は未読。
limits.en: Neutral fixed4charge Cartesian-z slab only. YB is a finite-gap approximation, not exact2P at arbitrary vacuum. Original Yeh full text not inspected.

references.title: Fast and spectrally accurate Ewald summation for2-periodic electrostatic systems
references.review_scope: Eq4 and AppendixA Eq41/zero-mode inspected; rendered selected pages requested. No full-paper audit or spectral-PME implementation claimed.

references.title: Ewald summation for systems with slab geometry
references.review_scope: Original publisher full text unavailable; no original-text review claimed. Neutral correction independently derived and checked against official LAMMPS implementation/documentation.

references.title: LAMMPS slab Ewald documentation and neutral correction
references.review_scope: Slab geometry restrictions and official Ewald::slabcorr neutral formula inspected. No LAMMPS code copied or executed; mutable stable source is contextual, not a numerical dependency.

caption.ja: 固定入力を実際に計算した保存配列からの検証図。
caption.en: Validation figure from actual saved fixed-input calculation arrays.
